cohort: A low-risk pregnancy cohort (n = 7415) with spontaneous onset of labor was analyzed from a single Italian region for the period 2016-2018.
finding: The study found no significant difference in the number of spontaneous deliveries or other obstetric variables when comparing the two weeks after DST to the two weeks before DST.
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries at any gestational age showed no statistical difference between the two groups (before and after DST).
